ev.q: Among 287 (95%) students with mumps for whom clinical information was available, 20 (7%) patients with complications were identified
this case series demonstrates that complications still occur, even in persons who have received the recommended 2 doses
The 20 cases included 15 (5%) cases of orchitis, three (1%) of transient hearing loss, two of mastitis, and one of meningitis
